metadata.title: Projective Braids in $\mathbb{R}P^3$
metadata.abstract: Links in projective space $\mathbb{R}P^3$ can be represented by diagrams in $\mathbb{R}P^2$ where the projective plane $\mathbb{R}P^2$ is represented by a disk with antipodal identifications on the boundary. In this context if we place an $n-$strand braid $\beta$ on this disk keeping its end points on the boundary then due to the identification of antipodal points it naturally represents a link diagram in $\mathbb{R}P^3$. We call this the projective closure of the braid $\beta$. In this paper we show that not all links in $\mathbb{R}P^3$ possess a diagram represented by projective closure of some braid.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究通过圆盘边界对径识别得到 RP³ 链环的辫子射影闭合，证明并非所有 RP³ 链环都具有这种表示。
analysis.breakthrough: 明确一种自然射影闭辫构造无法覆盖全部链环。
analysis.limitations: 否定针对特定射影闭合表示方式，不应误读为所有射影空间辫表示理论均失败。
analysis.priorityReason: 明确一种自然射影闭辫构造无法覆盖全部链环。
